title: summaryByVisit
text: demonstrate various functionalities function, create small dataset. three hypotetical lab-values: LDH, ANC Lymphocytes two categorical variables, grade stage. lab-value measured 10 time points (visits), can divided three visit groups (baseline, treatment follow-). addition, grouping variable called ‘arm’.
code: data<-NULL visit <- c(paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10))),            paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10))),            paste0(rep("Visit ", 10), rbind(c(1:10)))) data <- as.data.frame(cbind( visit, rnorm(30))) data<-as.data.frame(rbind(data, data, data, data, data)) data$visitgroup<- ifelse(data$visit %in% c("Visit 1", "Visit 2"), "Baseline", ifelse(data$visit %in% c("Visit 3", "Visit 4"), "Treatment", "Follow-up")) data$visitgroup<-factor(data$visitgroup, levels = c("Baseline", "Treatment", "Follow-up")) data$LDH<-rnorm(150) data$Lymphocytes<-rnorm(150) data$ANC<-rnorm(150) data$LDH[3]<-NA data$stage <- c(rep("II", 75), rep("I", 75)) data$stage <- ifelse(data$Lymphocytes>1.5, NA, data$stage) data$grade <- c(rep("IV", 50), rep("III", 50), rep("II", 25), rep("I", 25)) data$arm<- c(rep("Arm A", 70), rep("Arm B", 80))

title: summaryByVisit
text: Now, use summarySCI::summaryLevels create summary table median range lab-value visit.
code: summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          visit = "visit",           add_n = TRUE)

title: summaryByVisit
text: can visit group group visits accordingly. Visitgroup needs ordered factor.
code: summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          visitgroup = "visitgroup",          visit = "visit")

title: summaryByVisit
text: can stratify table groups via group argument. overall column can still shown desired, using overall = TRUE argument. maximum 3 groups supported.
code: summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          group = "arm",          visitgroup = "visitgroup",          visit = "visit") summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          group = "arm",          overall = TRUE,          visitgroup = "visitgroup",          visit = "visit")

title: summaryByVisit
text: Sample size can shown column, option add_n set TRUE.
code: summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          group = "arm",          overall = TRUE,          visitgroup = "visitgroup",          visit = "visit",          add_n = TRUE)

title: summaryByVisit
text: labels can changed using “labels” statement.
code: summaryByVisit(data,          vars = c("LDH", "Lymphocytes", "stage"),          labels=c("LDH (g/L)", "Lymphocytes (g)", "Stage"),          group = "arm",          overall = TRUE,          visitgroup = "visitgroup",          visit = "visit",          add_n = TRUE)

title: summaryTable
text: demonstrate various functionalities function use dataset survival::colon. dataset colon contains data 1858 patients one first successful trials adjuvant chemotherapy colon cancer. simplicity, focus recurrence , two treatment groups, four variable: treatment group (rx), sex (Male), age (age) extent local spread (extent). also add missing values variable extent.
code: library(survival) data(cancer, package="survival")  colon1 <-  colon %>%   group_by(id) %>%   slice(1) %>% # Select the first row within each id group   ungroup() set.seed(123) colon2 <- colon1 %>%   select(rx, sex, age, extent) %>%   filter(rx != "Lev") %>%   mutate(rx = if_else(rx == "Obs", "Control", rx),          extent = if_else(row_number() %in% sample(row_number(), size = round(0.1 * n())), NA, extent)) %>%    rename(Male = sex) %>%    mutate(extent = as.factor(extent)) head(colon2) #> # A tibble: 6 × 4 #>   rx       Male   age extent #>   <chr>   <dbl> <dbl> <fct>  #> 1 Lev+5FU     1    43 3      #> 2 Lev+5FU     1    63 3      #> 3 Control     0    71 2      #> 4 Lev+5FU     0    66 3      #> 5 Control     1    69 3      #> 6 Lev+5FU     0    57 3

title: Boxplot over time — boxplotSCI
text: data data frame tibble containing data plotted. var Name column data indicating measurement plotted. Supports bare quoted column names. time Name column data containing time points interest. time points can either numeric, character, factor. time points factors, factor levels must correct chronological order plotting. left empty, function assume single time point. character, need able ordered numerical logic. time_labels Name column data containing descriptive labels time points. Optional. group Name column data containing grouping variables (e.g., treatment arms). left empty, function assume single group. group_names character vector containing names groups displayed legend. order must match levels(factor(data$group)). Default NULL, falls back group names found data. group_names_short character vector containing short names abbreviations groups, displayed x-axis near patient counts. Optional. Defaults group_names. main Title plot. Defaults "" (title). xlab label x-axis. Default "Time" multiple time points, otherwise defaults "Group". ylab label y-axis. Default "Variable". ylim y-axis limits plot numeric vector length 2. Default NULL, adds 10% padding buffer data range. y_ticks numeric vector specifying explicit tick positions y-axis. Default NULL, calculates 5 evenly spaced ticks across data range. col character vector hex colors color names use boxes. Default NULL, automatically applies SCI color palette. cex_lab numeric value specifying font size main axis labels. Default 1. cex_axis numeric value specifying font size axis tick marks. Default 1. cex_n_patients numeric value specifying font size sample size labels numbers displayed beneath horizontal axis. Default 0.7. boxwex Scale factor width boxes. Default NULL, scales box flexibly size total timepoints groups. shift numeric value indicating distance adjacent boxes within timepoint cluster. Default NULL, dynamically sets spacing boxwex * 1.15. mar_custom numeric vector indicating plot margins used form c(bottom, left, top, right). Default NULL, dynamically calculates spacing stacked sample-size rows never clipped. xlab_line numeric value indicating margin line offset x-axis label. Default NULL, calculates adaptive offset based number groups. ylab_line numeric value indicating margin line offset y-axis label. Default 3.0. xlab_position Horizontal position coordinate adjustment sample size group headers left-hand margin. Default NULL, auto-aligns . lines numeric vector indicating vertical coordinates horizontal reference lines plotted. Optional. lty numeric vector length 1 length lines indicating line type plotted. Default 1 (solid). col_lines character vector length 1 length lines indicating color reference lines. Default "grey". legend_position Position legend box. Options include standard base R keywords (e.g., "topright", "topleft", "bottom") manual numeric coordinate pairs c(x, y). Default "topright". legend_offset numeric vector length 2 specifying inset nudge legend position away plot elements. Default c(0, 0). legend_cex numeric value specifying font element scaling size inside legend box. Default 1. legend_bty type box border drawn around legend. Allowed values "n" (transparent/border, default) "o" (standard box frame). missing_nr numeric character value indicating zero-count patient sizes x-axis displayed. Default 0. Can also set NA. color_time logical toggle switch enabling legacy timepoint colorization. Supports legacy use, , single timepoint, multiple groups used "timepoint" variable. set TRUE, treats timepoints individual categories,applying sequential coloring rendering matching tracking legend. Default FALSE.

title: Creates publication-ready summary tables for continuous data grouped, by visit — summaryByVisit
text: data data frame tibble containing data summarized. vars Continuous variables include summary table. Need specified quotes, e.g. "age" c("age", "response"). Default variables present data except group. group single column data. Need specified quotes, e.g. "treatment". Summary statistics stratified according variable. Default NULL. maximum 3 groups currently supported. labels list containing labels used variables table. NULL, labels automatically taken dataset. label present, variable name taken. stat_cont Summary statistic display continuous variables. Options include "median_IQR", "median_range" (default), "mean_sd", "mean_se" "geomMean_sd". stat_cat Summary statistic display categorical variables. Options include "n", "n_N" "n_percent" (default). visit Name stratum summary statistics displayed line. Typically, "visit". order numerical variable defining visit order. visitgroup grouping variable stratum summary statistics displayed line. Must ordered factor. Typically, visit group e.g., baseline, follow-etc. digits_cont Digits summary statistics CI continuous variables. Default 1. digits_cat Digits summary statistics CI categorical variables. Default 1. missing_percent Indicates whether percentages missings shown (TRUE, default) (FALSE) categorical variables. "", options displayed next . missing Logical. TRUE (default), missing values shown. missing_text String indicating text shown missing row. Default "Missing". add_n Logical. TRUE, additional column total number non-missing observations variable added. overall Logical. TRUE, additional column total added table. Ignored, groups defined. Default FALSE. as_flex_table Logical. TRUE (default) gtsummary object converted flextable object. Useful rendering Word. border Logical. TRUE, border drawn around table. available flex_table = TRUE. Default TRUE. word_output Logical. TRUE, table also saved word document. file_name Character string. Specify name Word document containing table. used word_output TRUE. Needs end ".docx".

title: Creates publication-ready summary tables for continuous data grouped, by visit — summaryByVisit
text: table class "flextable" c("tbl_strata_nested_stack", "tbl_stack", "gtsummary"). Optionally returns .docx file specified folder.
